policy.default: PROHIBITED — a dataset not listed here as approved must not enter the training pipeline
policy.youtube: No YouTube scraping under any license interpretation (decision #97)
policy.isolation: non-approved datasets must live outside the training data root; the pipeline validates provenance against this registry before ingest

datasets.name: COCO 2017 Keypoints
datasets.verdictBasis: annotations are CC-BY-4.0, but the images themselves carry individual Flickr licenses that vary per photo — bulk commercial reuse is not guaranteed; usable only with per-image license review or as pretraining-only context
datasets.notes: MediaPipe-class backbones already train on COCO — using a pretrained backbone inherits no direct COCO licensing obligation for our downstream model, but we never redistribute COCO images.

datasets.name: MPII Human Pose
datasets.verdictBasis: MPII terms restrict use to scientific research — commercial training use is excluded
datasets.notes: Hard exclusion. May not enter storage used by the training pipeline.

datasets.name: Penn Action Dataset
datasets.verdictBasis: released for academic/research purposes; no commercial license grant found
datasets.notes: Exercise-relevant labels (squat, push-up) but rights do not extend to commercial product training.

datasets.name: Kinetics (400/600/700)
datasets.verdictBasis: annotations CC-BY but the media are YouTube-hosted videos — no redistribution or download rights, and YouTube scraping is independently banned (decision #97)
datasets.notes: Doubly excluded: YouTube provenance + no media redistribution rights.

datasets.name: UCF-101
datasets.verdictBasis: CRCV terms grant use for research and educational purposes only; sourced largely from YouTube
datasets.notes: Also collides with the no-YouTube rule via its provenance.

datasets.name: Pexels videos
datasets.verdictBasis: license permits free commercial use and modification, but prohibits selling unaltered copies and requires no endorsement implication; ML-training use is not expressly addressed — conservative classification pending counsel review of the license text
datasets.notes: Candidate for licensed ingest after review; identifiable people in videos raise publicity-rights questions the license does not solve.

datasets.name: Pixabay videos
datasets.verdictBasis: license permits commercial use/modification, but training AI/ML models on content is not clearly granted; conservative classification pending counsel review

datasets.name: Humai consented self-recordings (P3 platform)
datasets.verdictBasis: collected under the internal consent workflow — landmark storage by default, raw video only with separate explicit consent, withdrawal cascade per playbook
datasets.notes: The primary corpus. Consent record per participant required before ingest (pose/dataset/consent-record.schema.json).

datasets.name: Synthetic landmark fixtures (P5-generated)
datasets.verdictBasis: synthetic fixtures may be used for unit/integration tests and augmentation ablations only — never presented as evaluation evidence of real-world accuracy
datasets.notes: No anatomically impossible synthetics; separation enforced in the pipeline.
